title: Contractions and applications of crystal skeletons: Young quasisymmetric and Stanley symmetric functions
summary: The character of a connected $\mathfrak{sl}_n$-crystal is a Schur polynomial; the crystal can be further decomposed into quasicrystals, whose characters are the Gessel quasisymmetric functions. Crystal skeletons are obtained by contracting quasicrystals within crystal graphs. They generalize dual equivalence graphs, and can be used to prove the Schur expansion of a symmetric function when the quasisymmetric expansion is known.
